headline_marked: Malaysia to [[recruit 200,000 Bangladeshi workers]] starting September
headline: Malaysia to recruit 200,000 Bangladeshi workers starting September
summary: State Minister for Local Government, Rural Development and Co-operatives Mir Shah Alam announced the recruitment drive starting next month.
details: The Malaysian government will recruit approximately 200,000 Bangladeshi workers through various recruiting agencies, according to State Minister Mir Shah Alam.
In addition to the main recruitment drive, Malaysia has also expressed interest in taking 10,000 Bangladeshi workers free of cost.
These announcements were made following a meeting between the State Minister and the Malaysian Ambassador to Bangladesh at the Secretariat in Dhaka.
Beyond labor recruitment, the two nations agreed to collaborate on road construction technology. Bangladesh will adopt Malaysia's rubber-mixed bitumen technology to make roads more sustainable.
Malaysia will provide technical assistance to Bangladesh for the implementation of this rubber-mixed bitumen road technology.
The State Minister also noted that Malaysia will provide cooperation in the renewable energy sector.
On a separate note, the State Minister announced that rickshaws will be banned from the main roads of the capital city, Dhaka, as laws have already been passed.
Two and four-seater e-rickshaws will be brought under registration, while six-seater e-rickshaws will be banned from Dhaka and only be allowed in other urban areas under registration.
caption:

The State Minister also noted that Malaysia will provide cooperation in the renewable energy sector.

On a separate note, the State Minister announced that rickshaws will be banned from the main roads of the capital city, Dhaka, as laws have already been passed.

Two and four-seater e-rickshaws will be brought under registration, while six-seater e-rickshaws will be banned from Dhaka and only be allowed in other urban areas under registration.

headline_marked: Actress [[Tasnuva Tisha survives road accident]] near Bhairab
headline: Actress Tasnuva Tisha survives road accident near Bhairab
summary: The actress and her team narrowly escaped injury after their vehicle was hit by a pickup truck while returning from a shoot in Sreemangal.
details: Actress Tasnuva Tisha and her team were involved in a road accident near the toll plaza in Bhairab while returning to Dhaka from a drama shoot in Sreemangal.
Tisha shared the details during a Facebook Live session shortly after midnight on Saturday, August 29, describing the incident as a serious accident.
According to the actress, a pickup truck hit their car after they had crossed the Bhairab Bridge and then attempted to drive away from the scene.
The pickup truck was later pursued on a motorcycle and stopped. Police arrived at the scene following the incident to handle the situation.
While the vehicle sustained significant damage, Tisha confirmed that no one in the car was injured, stating that they narrowly escaped.
